mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate, indicating monetary tightening, leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive (>0%) despite FEDFUNDS increasing by >0.25% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates signal a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and spending, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE being below 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates expanding construction activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite HOUST increasing by >5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP and retail sales increase simultaneously, it signals strong aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS increasing in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests supply chain constraints or reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO decreasing by >1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates indicate easy monetary conditions, reducing borrowing costs and increasing investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS being below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high employment levels coupled with rising unemployment rates signal labor market tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite PAYEMS being high and UNRATE increasing by >0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite GDPC1 growth rate being below 2% YoY.
